info.name: Two-layer film with a thickness budget
info.short_description: Simulated: two films on silicon whose total thickness is known to be 90 A, kept by inequality constraints during the fit.

background.description: Linear background to include in reflectometry data

guide_field_angle.description: Angle of the applied field about the beam axis (refl1d Aguide): 270 or -90 degrees is in the sample plane, 0 or 180 along the surface normal.

applied_field.description: Magnitude of the applied field (refl1d H). It adds a Zeeman term along the field direction, so its effect depends on the field and its orientation relative to the moments.

sld.description: The real scattering length density for a material in e-6 per squared angstrom.

isld.description: The imaginary scattering length density for a material in e-6 per squared angstrom.

thickness.description: The thickness of the layer in angstroms

roughness.description: The interfacial roughness, Nevot-Croce, for the layer in angstroms.
